b42f66655812b97f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل عن أخصائي بيئي للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة مكة المكرمة، بمدينة الطائف. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات وسياسات حماية البيئة، وضمان الالتزام بالمعايير البيئية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتطوير الاستراتيجيات والسياسات والتعليمات والإجراءات المتعلقة بمراقبة وحماية البيئة، مثل استراتيجيات معالجة المياه المنزلية والصناعية وسياسات التخلص من النفايات. دراسة وتحديد وإعداد المعايير والمواصفات الوطنية الخاصة برقابة البيئة وحمايتها، بما في ذلك ملوثات الهواء والمياه والتربة، ومستويات الإشعاع، وطبقة الأوزون، والتغير المناخي. تحديد مواصفات الأجهزة المستخدمة في الرقابة البيئية وحماية البيئة، مثل أجهزة قياس تلوث الهواء والمياه والإشعاعات، ومتابعة توفيرها وتشغيلها وضمان جاهزيتها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال البيئي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج أعمال حماية البيئة، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال حماية البيئة أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ السياسات والإجراءات البيئية. فهم عميق للمعايير والمواصفات البيئية الوطنية والدولية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات البيئية وتقديم التوصيات. مهارات تواصل فعالة لعرض النتائج وتوضيحها. القدرة على متابعة التطورات التقنية في مجال حماية البيئة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الطائف، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق متخصص يعمل على تحقيق أهداف الشركة في مجال الصيانة والتشغيل مع الالتزام بأعلى معايير حماية البيئة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة زهران للصيانة والتشغيل.

b45a03048feda143.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Life Guard to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This is a full-time position focused on ensuring the safety of swimmers and maintaining the recreational facility. The role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Utilize appropriate rescue techniques for swimmers requiring assistance. Monitor the swimming area for dangerous conditions, unusual activities, and swimmers in distress. Promote and enforce the rules and regulations of the recreational facility. Identify situations where guests may be unable to safely participate in an activity and inform the supervisor or manager. Provide assistance to injured guests until emergency medical services arrive. Contribute to an entertaining and relaxing atmosphere for guests. Obtain, fold, and stack towels according to company procedures. Wash, mop, and clean the pool perimeter. Report accidents, injuries, and hazardous working conditions to the manager. Operational Duties and Safety Compliance Adhere to all chain safety policies and procedures, including reporting maintenance issues, accident risks, accidents, or injuries. Maintain a clean and professional uniform and appearance. Respect the confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company property. Support colleagues and treat them with dignity and respect, contributing to team goals. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Greet and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Communicate using clear, appropriate, and professional language, and answer the phone with proper etiquette. Perform other tasks as requested by managers that are consistent with the position. Physical Requirements Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds (* kg) without assistance. Assist in moving, lifting, carrying, transporting, and placing objects weighing over 75 pounds (34 kg). Stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or a full shift. Move at the speed required to respond to work situations (*, running, walking, jogging). Visually inspect tools, equipment, and machinery to identify defects. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of different sizes and weights requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Reach objects overhead and below the knees, including bending, body rotations, pulling, and stooping. Move on sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces. Climb ladders, stairs, and service ramps. Qualifications and Experience Education Level: High school diploma or equivalent. Related Work Experience: No related work experience is required. Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience is required. Ability to follow safety training and obtain required certifications. Application Information This full-time position offers an opportunity to contribute to guest safety and facility maintenance at Sheraton Hotels & Resorts in Dammam. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b491ba5bf1aefaff.description: About the Role Hays is seeking an experienced GRC Risk & IAM Architect to join a large-scale cybersecurity architecture and governance program. This contract role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a highly regulated financial services environment. The position focuses on cybersecurity governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), application security, and security architecture assurance. Role Purpose The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring that security controls are aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. This involves leading cybersecurity risk and compliance activities and supporting the review and approval of architecture designs from a security and compliance perspective. Key Responsibilities Lead cybersecurity risk and compliance activities across enterprise architecture initiatives. Conduct security architecture risk assessments and control gap analyses. Map and assess security controls against regulatory and industry standards, including SAMA Cybersecurity Framework, NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC), PCI DSS, and ISO 27001. Define and maintain governance processes related to security architecture, risk management, and compliance. Support the review and approval of architecture designs from a security and compliance perspective. Manage security exceptions, risk acceptance processes, and remediation plans. Prepare audit evidence and support internal and external audit activities. Define and enforce IAM and PAM architecture standards and best practices. Support authentication, authorization, single sign-on (SSO), identity federation, and access governance initiatives. Review application and API security architectures to ensure secure design principles are implemented. Support secure SDLC initiatives and security-by-design practices. Define requirements for data protection, encryption, cryptographic controls, and key management. Collaborate with cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, infrastructure, application development, risk, and compliance teams. Contribute to cybersecurity architecture governance, continuous improvement, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Experience within banking, financial services, fintech, or other highly regulated environments. Hands-on experience with IAM and PAM technologies. Experience supporting compliance initiatives and regulatory assessments. Strong knowledge of application security, API security, encryption, and key management frameworks. Experience working within enterprise cybersecurity architecture and governance functions. Work Environment This is a contract position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, operating within a large-scale cybersecurity architecture and governance program in the financial services sector.

b4c2499ea9e96858.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform recognized as a Great Place to Work®. The company specializes in conversational AI for emerging markets, serving over 5,000 enterprises across MENA. Unifonic is pioneering sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform, with a focus on shaping market perception among buyers, analysts, and media. The Sales Team at Unifonic The Sales team at Unifonic focuses on driving revenue while serving as trusted consultants to customers. This team comprises experts in account management, business development, and customer service, collaborating with other departments to ensure products and services meet customer needs. The team seeks individuals with a proven track record in sales, strong relationship-building skills, and a commitment to customer support. Role Overview: Strategic Account Manager As a Strategic Account Manager based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, you will be responsible for managing and expanding a portfolio of high-value enterprise accounts within regulated industries, including government, financial services, telecommunications, and large enterprises. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves building and maintaining trusted relationships with senior stakeholders to drive customer retention and revenue growth. You will manage renewals, identify expansion opportunities, and ensure long-term customer success. Key Responsibilities Own and manage a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts. Achieve and exceed annual recurring revenue (ARR), expansion, upsell, and retention targets. Develop and execute account plans for key customers. Identify and drive cross-sell and upsell opportunities across the product portfolio. Lead contract renewals and commercial negotiations. Build trusted relationships with C-level, business, and technical stakeholders. Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic customers. Conduct executive business reviews and governance meetings. Ensure customer objectives align with company capabilities and roadmap. Monitor customer health, adoption, satisfaction, and business outcomes. Manage escalations and coordinate resolution across internal teams. Improve retention and reduce churn risk through proactive engagement. Drive successful onboarding and service expansion initiatives. Prepare quarterly account reviews, forecasts, and business plans. Maintain accurate account data, opportunity tracking, and forecasting within CRM. Coordinate with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Delivery, Finance, and Legal teams. Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and internal processes. Maintain a strong understanding of regulated sectors and industry trends in Saudi Arabia. Provide customer feedback to Product and Leadership teams. Represent the company in strategic customer engagements and industry events. Benefits Competitive salary and bonus. GOSI costs covered by the company. Unifonic share scheme. 30 holiday days after the first anniversary. Birthday off. Up to 5 weeks per year for remote work from any location globally. Paid leave for new parents.

b4e57469f19991c8.description: About Merit Incentives Merit Incentives is seeking a Cybersecurity Lead to enhance the security posture of its digital platforms, applications, cloud environment, internal systems, and client integrations. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on strengthening security across Saudi Arabia and international markets. Role Overview The Cybersecurity Lead will be responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating cybersecurity risks. This role involves hands-on security management, incident response coordination, and collaboration with technology teams to integrate security requirements into new developments. The ideal candidate will possess broad cybersecurity knowledge and strong practical experience, without necessarily being a specialist in every domain. Key Responsibilities Identify and assess cybersecurity risks impacting the company’s platforms, applications, systems, employees, clients, and data. Monitor and respond to cybersecurity incidents, coordinating containment and corrective actions. Review the security of cloud environments, web and mobile applications, APIs, endpoints, networks, and access controls. Conduct or coordinate vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, security reviews, and remediation activities. Collaborate with Technology, Product, and DevOps teams to integrate security requirements into new systems, applications, and integrations. Maintain cybersecurity policies, risk assessments, incident response procedures, and security reports. Support compliance with applicable requirements such as ISO/IEC 27001, Saudi PDPL, NCA controls, and PCI DSS, as well as client security assessments. Promote cybersecurity awareness and provide clear recommendations on security risks and priorities to management. Qualifications and Requirements Saudi National. Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of relevant cybersecurity or information security experience. Practical knowledge of cloud security, application and API security, incident response, vulnerability management, endpoint security, and identity and access management. Experience working with cloud-based platforms, web applications, APIs, or digital products. Ability to investigate security issues, assess business impact, and recommend practical solutions. Strong communication, documentation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills. Professional proficiency in both Arabic and English. Preferred Qualifications Experience in SaaS, fintech, payments, loyalty platforms, digital marketplaces, e-commerce, or enterprise technology environments. Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001, Saudi PDPL, NCA controls, and PCI DSS. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, Security+, CySA+, CEH, ISO/IEC 27001, or a cloud security certification. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

b457a330a7773ff9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات عن فني عمليات تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تطبيق وتنفيذ الخطط المتعلقة بعمليات تقنية المعلومات، وتقديم الدعم الفني اللازم. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطبيق وتنفيذ الخطط الفنية المرسومة المتعلقة بعمليات تقنية المعلومات والالتزام بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. تحديد الأدوات والمستلزمات المطلوبة للقيام بالعمليات المتعلقة بتقنية المعلومات، ورفع النواقص إلى المعنيين لتأمينها. تقديم المساعدة الفنية لمهندس وأخصائي تقنية المعلومات في أداء مهامهم واختصاصاتهم، وتنفيذ المهام الموكلة إليه. حفظ البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بكافة عمليات تقنية المعلومات الفنية، والعمل على تبويبها وترتيبها بالاستناد إلى الممارسات المعتمدة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل دوري. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال عمليات تقنية المعلومات أو دور مشابه. فهم جيد لخطط وسياسات وإجراءات تقنية المعلومات. القدرة على تحديد وتأمين الأدوات والمستلزمات التقنية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في تقديم الدعم الفني والمساعدة. القدرة على تنظيم وحفظ البيانات والمعلومات التقنية. مهارات إعداد التقارير وتوثيق العمل. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق تقنية المعلومات في شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات. سيتم العمل في بيئة داعمة تهدف إلى تحقيق أفضل الممارسات في عمليات تقنية المعلومات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة. نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين على التقديم.

b4a3cd0862843bf1.description: About the Role مدارس المجموعة العالمية (ISG) is seeking an Instructional Assistant - Laboratory for a full-time position in Al Khobar or Dhahran, Ash Sharqiyah. This role provides essential technical support for practical Biology, Chemistry, and Physics across the Senior School. It is a non-teaching position, with teachers retaining responsibility for lesson planning, instruction, assessment, and student supervision. Key Responsibilities The Instructional Assistant will work closely with the Head of Science and teaching staff to ensure laboratories, preparation rooms, and stores are organized and ready for use. Key responsibilities include: Coordinating practical requests and laboratory bookings with science teachers. Preparing and checking apparatus, specimens, reagents, and solutions to agreed specifications. Trialling unfamiliar practical procedures as agreed with teaching staff. Providing technical assistance during teacher-led demonstrations, investigations, and practical assessments. Clearing and resetting laboratories after use, cleaning apparatus, and disposing of waste through approved procedures. Laboratory Safety and Equipment Management This role involves maintaining a safe and organized laboratory environment, including adherence to safety protocols and efficient management of equipment and stock. Specific duties include: Following BSD’s laboratory safety procedures and agreed risk assessments. Contributing technical information on hazards, equipment, and materials during activity planning. Labelling, handling, and storing chemicals, specimens, and other materials in line with school procedures. Maintaining accurate inventories and ensuring safety information is accessible. Carrying out routine checks and basic maintenance, reporting defects, and coordinating servicing. Monitoring stock levels, anticipating demand, and preparing orders for chemicals, consumables, and equipment. Keeping laboratories, preparation rooms, and stores orderly and secure. Reporting hazards, incidents, and near misses promptly, and following school emergency procedures. School Ethos and Professional Conduct The successful candidate will uphold the school's values and commitment to student welfare. This includes: Supporting ISG’s mission, “We inspire innovation and compassionate action,” and modelling its core values of Respect, Acceptance, Integrity, and Responsibility. Safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students. Following ISG’s child protection procedures, reporting concerns promptly, maintaining professional boundaries, and completing required training. Working constructively with colleagues and participating in relevant professional learning. Additional Duties The Instructional Assistant may be assigned other duties by the principal and/or the Assistant Principals as needed to support the school's operations.

b4a5b989a9dc1ad6.description: About Saint-Gobain GCC Saint-Gobain designs, manufactures, and distributes materials and solutions across the construction, mobility, and industrial markets. Through continuous innovation, the company provides integrated solutions that deliver sustainability and performance in daily life. These solutions address the renovation of public and private buildings, light construction, and the decarbonization of construction and industry. Saint-Gobain is committed to reducing carbon emissions, leveraging resource efficiency, and increasing circularity, guided by its purpose: "MAKING THE WORLD A BETTER HOME". The Role of Sales Coordinator (Tamheer) Saint-Gobain GCC is seeking a Sales Coordinator for a full-time position in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This role is part of the Tamheer program and is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, providing an opportunity to contribute to the sales support functions within a global organization. Key Responsibilities Receive purchase orders from sales staff and inform the sales executive. Process requests from sales staff regarding offers or information. Coordinate and follow up with the logistics team to ensure timely delivery of orders. Monitor and follow up on approvals to ensure orders are placed promptly. Prepare quotations for the sales team. Compile daily sales and pending orders reports for the Sales Manager. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Eligibility for the Tamheer program. Strong organizational and coordination skills. Ability to communicate effectively with internal teams. Work Location and Type This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities covering the Jeddah and Makkah regions.

b4ceba51d3149876.description: تعلن شركة عن توفر فرصة وظيفية بمسمى بائعة في محل عطور، للعمل ضمن فريق المبيعات. الشروط والمتطلبات: يُفضّل أن تكون المتقدمة سعودية الجنسية. اللباقة وحسن التعامل مع العملاء. مهارات الإقناع والبيع والتسويق. الاهتمام بالمظهر وحسن التواصل. الالتزام والانضباط في أوقات العمل. يُفضّل وجود خبرة سابقة في مجال العطور والمبيعات. للتقديم يرجي ارسال السيرة الذاتية علي الايميل i@************

b427f1b969d4ebc4.description: About the Role Canonical is seeking a Senior Communications Manager, Analyst Relations, to join its communications team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves driving communications strategy through the analyst relations (AR) channel to enhance Canonical’s visibility among industry influencers and shape market perception. The position requires 5-10 years of experience and reports to the Director of Communications. Role Context and Objectives The Senior Communications Manager will define and implement a strategy for data-driven engagement across Canonical's diverse portfolio. This includes building on key narratives, developing new ones, and establishing relationships with analysts and industry influencers to advance the company's market position and foster long-term brand equity. The role involves close partnership with Product Management, Alliances, Sales, and Marketing teams to communicate product news and manage perception among analysts. The successful candidate will also contribute to shaping the AR field within the company, leveraging technologies like AI for market research and perception assessment. Key Responsibilities Prepare and execute analyst-focused communications plans for product announcements, new partnerships, and other initiatives aligned with the go-to-market strategy. Proactively identify opportunities to use new technologies, such as AI, for analyzing market trends and assessing analyst perception and sentiment of Canonical and its products. Understand GenAI platforms developed by analyst firms and ensure they contain accurate information about Canonical’s portfolio. Craft and deliver compelling narratives about Canonical and its products in line with the company vision. Manage analyst relationships directly, coordinating touchpoints throughout the year via online briefings and industry events. Measure the impact of the AR program, report regularly on progress to leadership, implement necessary tooling to improve collaboration, and manage spend. Proactively position the company in key analyst reports to drive recommendations and strengthen the company’s brand. Support the Director of Communications on Corporate Communications initiatives. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in communications, with a focus on analyst relations (AR). Demonstrated experience in driving communications strategy through AR channels. Passion for technology and curiosity about the evolving AR field. Ability to communicate a diverse product range based on open source. Experience with data-driven engagement strategies and market research. About Canonical Canonical is a provider of open source software and operating systems, including Ubuntu, which is used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. The company operates as a global distributed collaboration with over 1200 colleagues in more than 75 countries. Canonical has been a remote-first company since 2004, with teams meeting two to four times annually in person. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a workplace free from discrimination.

b4d8b66b7c3b9b86.description: About the Role Arabian Ceramics (سيراميك العربية) is seeking a Graphic Designer to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves planning, designing, and furnishing interior environments for various settings, including exhibitions, showrooms, dealer shops, and customer residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. The Graphic Designer will also be responsible for originating and developing design ideas for ceramic and porcelain products. Key Responsibilities Confer with management to determine scheme preferences, purpose, function of interior environments, budget, types of ceramics, and panels to be installed. Integrate findings with interior design knowledge to formulate practical, aesthetic, and purpose-driven ceramic environmental plans. Advise management on interior design factors such as space planning, layout, utilization of furnishings and equipment, and color schemes. Render design ideas through paste-ups, drawings, or illustrations, estimate material requirements and costs, and present designs for approval. Select or design and purchase furnishings, artworks, and accessories. Subcontract fabrication, installation, and arrangement of carpeting, fixtures, accessories, draperies, paint and wall coverings, art work, and furniture. Read publications, attend showings, and consult with engineers, marketing, production, and sales representatives to establish design concepts. Evaluate design ideas based on appearance, design-function relationships, serviceability, materials, engineering, application, budget, price, production costs, and market characteristics. Present design works to the design committee and discuss necessary modifications. Coordinate the preparation of working drawings from sketches and design specifications. Integrate findings, concepts, and sketches for custom application design ideas. Confer with administrative, curatorial, and exhibit staff to determine theme, content, purpose, and location of exhibits. Consider budget, promotion, and time limitations, and plan production schedules for exhibit component fabrication and installation. Prepare preliminary drawings of proposed exhibits, including detailed construction, layout, special effect diagrams, and material specifications. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in graphic design or interior design, with a focus on environmental and product design. A strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in planning, designing, and furnishing interior spaces, as well as product design, is essential. Skills and Competencies Proficiency in design software and rendering tools. Strong understanding of interior design principles, space planning, and color theory. Ability to translate concepts into detailed drawings and illustrations. Knowledge of materials, production methods, and cost estimation. Excellent communication and presentation skills to advise management and collaborate with various teams. Ability to manage multiple projects and adhere to deadlines. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, offering an opportunity to contribute to diverse design projects within a dynamic company environment. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b4f918643a6cf19e.description: About KBR Saudi Arabia KBR Saudi Arabia is seeking a Principal Designer to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. This is a full-time position for an experienced professional ready to apply advanced engineering techniques and leadership within a dynamic environment. Role Overview The Principal Designer operates with general supervision, independently applying advanced engineering techniques to solve complex problems. This role involves making critical decisions on engineering methods and representing the organization in conferences to resolve important questions or negotiate with key engineers and officials from other organizations. Key Responsibilities Provide technical guidance to designers and less experienced engineers, fostering their professional development. Serve as a primary consultant for associates and other stakeholders, with a high degree of reliance placed on scientific interpretations and advice. Manage measurable assets, including assigned staff and budget, ensuring efficient resource allocation and project delivery. Qualifications and Experience An undergraduate degree in Engineering is required. A minimum of 7 years of related experience is essential, with an average experience level typically exceeding 10 years. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia, within the Eastern Region. The role requires an individual capable of independent work while also providing significant technical leadership and consultation. Application Information Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

b42f96df6a7fbcc2.description: About Almarai Company Founded in 1977, Almarai Company is recognized as the world’s largest vertically integrated dairy company and the largest food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in the MENA region. Headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Almarai is ranked as the number one FMCG Brand in the MENA region and holds a market leadership position across its categories in the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. The company has sustained growth over five decades by providing nutritious products, guided by its principle: “Quality you can trust.” Almarai’s product portfolio includes dairy products, juices and beverages, baked goods, poultry, infant formula, dates, fish and seafood, and bottled water, marketed under more than 20 brands such as Almarai, L’usine, and ALYOUM. The company employs over 43,000 professionals across the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. In 2025, Almarai reported a net income of SAR billion on sales of SAR 22 billion. The Role of Business Analyst Almarai Company is seeking a Business Analyst to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves analyzing the performance of specific markets, company departments, or business processes within Almarai. The Business Analyst will identify areas for improvement, provide insights, and propose solutions to business owners for implementation. Key Responsibilities Conduct analyses of the Almarai portfolio linked to channels and customers, specific geographic or category-related markets, and Almarai’s sales performance in those markets. Evaluate promotional activities, cooler placements, and market share. Perform competitor analyses focusing on market share, portfolio, sales, and margin. Provide consultancy on distribution efficiency and overall sales performance. Identify opportunities for distribution optimization, including routes, number of calls, and refrigeration units in the market. Required Experience Candidates for the Business Analyst position should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in business analysis or a related field. Benefits and Compensation Almarai offers a competitive compensation package for this full-time role. Benefits include generous leave, comprehensive medical coverage, a discretionary bonus, and opportunities for training and development.

b461cc4248c07a81.description: About the Role Flow Progressive Logistics is seeking a Human Resources Supervisor for a full-time position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role involves overseeing daily HR operations and employee relations, ensuring efficient HR service delivery, accurate payroll coordination, and compliance with Saudi Labor Law and company policies. The Human Resources Supervisor will support employees and operational teams across key HR processes, maintaining a positive and compliant work environment. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day HR operational activities, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of employee services. Oversee employee records, employment contracts, documentation, and HR system updates. Monitor employee attendance, absences, leave balances, and related HR transactions. Coordinate employee onboarding, transfers, contract renewals, and offboarding procedures. Support employees and line managers with HR-related requests and operational matters. Prepare, review, and validate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, overtime, allowances, deductions, and other payroll adjustments. Coordinate with Payroll and Finance teams to ensure accurate and timely salary processing. b42050cbae8e6d8c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اصل الحكمة الطبية عن صيدلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى الصيدلي مسؤولية دراسة وتحضير التركيبات الدوائية، وتحديد احتياجات الصيدلية من الأدوية والتجهيزات، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم إجراءات التخزين والصرف. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مواصفات وتركيبات الأدوية والعقاقير والمواد الصيدلانية، وتحضيرها وصرفها وفقاً للوصفات الطبية. تحديد الآثار الجانبية المحتملة لاستخدام الأدوية وتأثيراتها على الإنسان. تقييم احتياجات الصيدلية من الأدوية والعلاجات وتحديد أنواعها وكمياتها ومواصفاتها. إعداد ومراجعة طلبات الشراء، ومتابعة توفير واستلام وتخزين الأدوية وفقاً لسجلات المخزون والأسس الصيدلانية. دراسة الوصفات الطبية وتجهيز الأدوية قبل صرفها، وتقديم الإرشادات للمرضى حول طريقة الاستعمال والآثار الجانبية المحتملة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال الصيدلة. إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالصيدلة في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصيدلة. القدرة على دراسة التركيبات الدوائية وتحضيرها بدقة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات تخزين وصرف الأدوية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية عالية لإدارة مخزون الصيدلية. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع المرضى وتقديم الإرشادات اللازمة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة العامة والإجراءات الصيدلانية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الطبية. بيئة العمل يعمل الصيدلي ضمن فريق شركة اصل الحكمة الطبية في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل داعمة تهدف إلى تقديم أفضل الخدمات الصيدلانية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

b49ae1c59a54348f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مطاعم لا تافولا إيتاليان عن نادل للانضمام إلى فريقها في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية استقبال العملاء وتقديم قوائم الطعام والمشروبات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة الطلبات وتقديم الفواتير. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال العملاء بترحيب وتزويدهم بقوائم الأطعمة والمشروبات. تلقي طلبات العملاء بدقة وتقديم الأطعمة والمشروبات بفعالية. الإجابة عن استفسارات العملاء وتقديم المشورة بشأن خيارات الأطعمة والمشروبات المتاحة. إعداد الطاولات وترتيبها وتنظيفها، بالإضافة إلى ترتيب محتوياتها من الأطباق والأواني وإعادتها إلى أماكنها المخصصة. تقديم الفواتير للعملاء واستلام وتسجيل المدفوعات النقدية، واستخدام آلات نقاط البيع (POS). التعامل مع شكاوى العملاء الأولية ورفعها إلى مسؤول الشكاوى لاتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو الضيافة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق وفي بيئة عمل سريعة الوتيرة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة ولباقة في التعامل مع العملاء. القدرة على إدارة الوقت وتنظيم المهام بفعالية. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل وضمان تقديم خدمة عالية الجودة. القدرة على استخدام آلات نقاط البيع (POS) واستلام المدفوعات. بيئة العمل يعمل النادل ضمن فريق مطاعم لا تافولا إيتاليان في المبرز، المنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة مطعم ديناميكية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وزملاء العمل لضمان تجربة طعام مميزة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

b4a8dc76d983bcda.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في قرية العليا والقريات. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق في المنشأة، مع التركيز على الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمواقع المادية والتصاميم والأثاث الحالية والمستقبلية. نطاق العمل يشمل هذا الدور العمل في مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بمنفذ الحديثة. يركز المدير على ضمان سير العمليات اليومية للمرافق بكفاءة، مع الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ومباشرة تنفيذها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية والتصاميم والأثاث، وتخطيط جداول الصيانة والتنظيف. الإشراف على أنشطة الصيانة وتنسيق عمليات التصليح لتقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد ومراجعة واعتماد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المرافق أو الأشغال العامة. القدرة على تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق بفعالية. فهم جيد لمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ولوائحها. مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. طبيعة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في المواقع المحددة ضمن منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في قرية العليا والقريات، للعمل في مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بمنفذ الحديثة.

b40b970f623797b4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صناع المراتب للصناعة عن أمين مخزن للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة حركة المواد والسلع داخل المستودع، بدءًا من الاستلام وحتى الصرف، مع ضمان دقة المخزون وتنظيمه. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى أمين المخزن مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان سير العمليات اللوجستية بسلاسة وكفاءة، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: استلام المواد والسلع الواردة إلى المستودع والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المحددة في طلبات الشراء أو التوريد أو العينات المعتمدة. تنظيم وترتيب البضائع والمعدات والمواد الأخرى داخل المستودع، ووضعها في الأماكن المخصصة لها، مع تثبيت البيانات الخاصة بها لسهولة الوصول إليها. تحضير المواد وتجهيزها وصرفها للجهات المعنية بموجب سندات صرف رسمية، وذلك وفقًا لآلية الصرف المعتمدة في الشركة. تحديد الاحتياجات من السلع والمواد عند وصول المخزون إلى حد الطلب، وحفظ جميع المعاملات المتعلقة بالإدخالات والإخراجات من المستودع. المشاركة الفعالة في عمليات جرد المخزون الدورية، ومطابقة نتائج الجرد الفعلي مع الأرصدة المسجلة في الدفاتر والسجلات. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحًا يمتلك المهارات الأساسية لإدارة المخزون بكفاءة ودقة. الخبرة المطلوبة لهذا المنصب هي: خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال أمناء المخازن أو إدارة المستودعات. نوع العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

b4642e9e0e789823.description: About Wosool Brand Communication Wosool Brand Communication is seeking an experienced Marketing Director to lead the marketing account for an animal welfare center. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Eastern Province, and requires a professional with 5-10 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Marketing Director will be responsible for developing comprehensive marketing strategies, managing the marketing team, and overseeing all deliverables. The role focuses on ensuring that all marketing activities align with client objectives and are executed effectively. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement marketing strategies and quarterly marketing plans. Oversee the execution of marketing strategies and monitor progress against established goals. Manage client relationships, including attending regular performance review meetings. Review and approve all marketing content and reports prior to submission. Monitor team performance, project deadlines, and adherence to project scope. Ensure the quality and timely delivery of all marketing activities. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a marketing leadership role. Demonstrated ability to develop and execute successful marketing strategies. Experience in client relationship management and team leadership. Work Environment and Conditions This is a full-time position located in Dammam, Eastern Province. The role requires the ability to travel to the animal welfare center and attend events as needed. Commitment to strict confidentiality requirements is essential. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

b48531d4f6554b9a.description: About the Role SASREF is seeking a Sr. Consultant Human Resources to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. This full-time position requires over 10 years of experience and involves supporting the Human Resources Manager and Section Heads in various HR functions, including policy design, implementation, and remuneration. The role also focuses on organizational development, talent management, and employee engagement strategies. Key Responsibilities Support the OD team on organizational structure, governance, and authority matrix issues. Suggest changes to organizational structure and functional statements; assist with workforce and succession planning. Aid the Staffing team in setting hiring matrices and advise on recruitment processes to ensure effective and timely hiring. Provide support to the C&B Section Head in developing and enhancing SASREF HR policies. Offer expert opinion on Compensation & Benefits and Performance Management, including merit pay, bonuses, incentives, and recognition programs. Assist with job evaluations and Role Profiles specific to SASREF. Support all teams with benchmarking needs as required. Assist the HR Manager in developing employee engagement strategies, including harnessing employee opinion, relevant improvement plans, and measuring effectiveness. Help the HR Manager with proposals for the BCC and SASREF Board. Act as an Internal Auditor for the HR department to ensure compliance with policies and guidelines, reporting any non-compliance to the HR Manager and relevant teams. Workplace Safety and Cybersecurity Compliance Ensure personal safety measures are always in place and actions do not jeopardize the safety of others. Adhere strictly to all IOWs, Safe Operating Procedures, and Safe Work Instructions to prevent WPS and PSM incidents. Comply with the SASREF HSE Policy, 5 Safety Principles, and 8 Life Saving Rules. Maintain SASREF’s cybersecurity by implementing best practices and adhering to all requirements when handling assets and data. Comply with SASREF’s information security policies at all times. Performance Indicators No personal injury or injury to a third party. No WPS or PSM incidents caused. Reporting all suspicious emails, including phishing tests. Zero failures in phishing campaign tests. 100% completion of assigned cybersecurity awareness courses. Zero cybersecurity violations or negative behavior. b4a1dd8710061e39.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نبع الطاقة للمقاولات عن فني صيانة إنشاءات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تفقد الإنشاءات وتحديد متطلبات الصيانة اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى تقدير الموارد ومتابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة لضمان الجودة والكفاءة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد الإنشاءات المطلوب صيانتها وجمع المعلومات والبيانات اللازمة عن المباني وطبيعتها وأعمال الصيانة المطلوبة. تقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة، وكذلك العمالة والتجهيزات اللازمة، وإعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل. إعداد وتقديم تقرير فني للمهندس المشرف أو لصاحب العمل يوضح طبيعة الصيانة وبرنامج العمل والتكلفة التقديرية. متابعة إجراءات الصيانة وضبط المواصفات والجودة لضمان تنفيذ الأعمال وفق المعايير المحددة. إعداد تقارير العمل وتقديمها وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة الإنشاءات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تفقد الإنشاءات وتحديد متطلبات الصيانة بدقة. مهارات جيدة في تقدير التكاليف والموارد اللازمة لأعمال الصيانة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية وخطط العمل. نوع الوظيفة والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. عن نبع الطاقة للمقاولات نبع الطاقة للمقاولات هي شركة متخصصة في مجال المقاولات، ملتزمة بتقديم خدمات عالية الجودة في مشاريعها المختلفة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

b4ba4847a5e10018.description: About the Role Nestlé is seeking an Operator to join their team in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves performing machine tending operations and operating various machines within a production environment. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to ensure efficient and optimal machine operation during production. The Operator is responsible for overseeing machine performance, conducting necessary checks, and maintaining equipment to support continuous production processes. Key Responsibilities Verify quantities of raw and packaging materials received from the warehouse against production orders to prevent breakdowns or delays. Conduct testing procedures to ensure machines operate optimally during production cycles. Adhere to and implement standard operating procedures for the production line. Monitor line equipment and parameters, submitting fault reports in case of any abnormalities. Participate in or lead shift operational reviews to discuss achievements and address issues. Verify the production date and batch number printed on bottles. Perform water quality treatment sampling and analysis using designated tools and equipment to confirm satisfactory treatment results. Maintain accurate logs and execute preventive and corrective maintenance on equipment. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a similar operational or production environment. Demonstrated ability to operate a variety of machines in a production setting. Familiarity with standard operating procedures and quality control processes. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within Nestlé's production facilities. The role involves working directly with production machinery and collaborating with a team to ensure operational efficiency. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this Operator position at Nestlé.

b4f59856a6cebc88.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الانجاز للتجارة والمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية، بدءاً من دراسة الموقع ووصولاً إلى مطابقة التنفيذ للمواصفات، مع التركيز على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات وجداول الكميات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بدقة. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية للمشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع والتأكد من مطابقته للمواصفات والمعايير المعتمدة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. فهم عميق للمبادئ الهندسية الإنشائية وتحليل التربة. القدرة على إعداد وتدقيق التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب التزاماً بالإشراف الميداني والمكتبي لضمان سير المشاريع وفقاً للخطط والمعايير. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة الانجاز للتجارة والمقاولات.

b4fbeb4665d7610d.description: About the Role Gold Apple is seeking a CCTV Room Controller to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves monitoring and managing CCTV systems to ensure the safety and security of retail premises. The ideal candidate will possess strong attention to detail and the ability to perform effectively under pressure. Key Responsibilities Monitor and operate the CCTV system to maintain security across retail premises. Conduct regular checks of CCTV equipment to ensure full operational functionality. Respond promptly to security breaches or alarms detected via the CCTV system. Maintain accurate records of all footage and incidents for future reference. Collaborate with security teams to address security concerns identified through CCTV monitoring. Adhere to all relevant privacy laws and regulations concerning the handling and storage of CCTV footage. Required Qualifications and Experience Proven experience as a CCTV Controller or in a similar role within a retail or security environment. Familiarity with various CCTV equipment and software. Essential Skills Ability to maintain focus and alertness during extended periods of monitoring. Excellent attention to detail and strong observation skills. Effective communication and teamwork abilities. Understanding of privacy laws and regulations relevant to CCTV monitoring. Capacity to remain calm and make quick decisions in high-pressure situations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring dedicated monitoring of security systems within a retail setting.

b40c8154eff19200.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الغزالي للتجارة عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بيع الساعات للعملاء وتقديم معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات والأسعار، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع. يتطلب الدور القدرة على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة للشركة. استقبال العملاء وتوجيههم داخل أقسام المتجر المختلفة. التجاوب مع استفسارات العملاء المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات. إعداد وتجهيز العروض الترويجية المتنوعة. تقديم معلومات دقيقة للعملاء تشمل ميزات المنتج، الأسعار، وخدمات ما بعد البيع. الإشراف على تناسق عمليات التخزين والكميات المعروضة على الرفوف. الإشراف على إجراءات استرجاع واستبدال المنتجات. تعريف العملاء بأحدث العروض والخصومات الخاصة بشكل مستمر. تقديم تقارير دورية عن ملاحظات العملاء إلى المدير المباشر. الاطلاع بشكل دائم على المنتجات والخدمات الجديدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على تحقيق نسبة المبيعات المطلوبة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة وفعالة. القدرة على تقديم حلول لشكاوى العملاء. القدرة على تقديم توصيات لاختيار المنتج المناسب للعملاء. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة تبوك. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق التميز في خدمة العملاء وأهداف المبيعات. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

b47dd7b340a5db81.description: About the Role Afaaq - Warehouse Branch is seeking a Loss Prevention Specialist Security & Loss Prevention to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is integral to maintaining the security and operational continuity of the company's operations network, which is known for its efficiency in delivering packages to customers daily. The specialist will provide security services across the end-to-end supply chain to protect personnel and prevent loss. Key Responsibilities Conduct regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. Collect information during investigations by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Identify process vulnerabilities and contribute to the development of mitigating measures. Maintain the physical integrity of sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of security systems, ensuring their functionality with subject matter experts and external suppliers. Interact daily with external security service providers to ensure high-quality service delivery and a smooth customer experience. Act as a point of contact and subject matter expert for internal and external departments (*, legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) on Security and Loss Prevention matters. Deliver loss prevention education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels. Operational Support and Compliance Support the resilience of business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within the area of responsibility. Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (*, loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions, ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards. Serve as a point of contact and coordinate risk management measures with local management and external stakeholders, including law enforcement agencies and industry associations, on all security-related matters. Ensure assigned sites comply with global security standards. Team and Organizational Context This role is part of the Global Security Operations organization, where the Security and Loss Prevention team supports business targets and strengthens the brand. This is achieved by protecting against relevant threats and managing security and loss prevention risks that could jeopardize associates and customers, disrupt business operations, damage assets, or negatively impact brand reputation. Approach to Security The team works in partnership with stakeholders to secure the supply chain end-to-end and promote security in business discussions. This involves preventing security and loss prevention-related risks and vulnerabilities as early as possible, intervening in unfolding incidents to minimize negative impact, and thoroughly investigating security-related incidents to identify and remove root causes, thereby preventing reoccurrence. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Salary information is not disclosed.

b48b97d54dfe8364.description: About 2P Perfect Presentation Since 2004, 2P Perfect Presentation has been a leader in Saudi Arabia’s ICT landscape, providing integrated technology solutions that support organizations in accelerating digital transformation and improving operational efficiency. The company delivers end-to-end solutions through its specialized business units and market expertise, maintaining a strong foundation in innovation and service excellence. Role Overview: CX Operations Manager 2P Perfect Presentation is seeking a CX Operations Manager to oversee the daily operations of its contact center in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring that all service-level agreements and performance metrics are consistently met. The position requires strong leadership, effective communication, and a comprehensive understanding of contact center operations, with an emphasis on optimizing processes and enhancing customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Manage and supervise a team of contact center agents, team leads, and supervisors to ensure high levels of customer service and productivity. Develop and implement strategies aimed at improving operational efficiency and meeting service level agreements. Monitor and analyze key performance indicators to identify areas for improvement, implement corrective actions, analyze outcomes, and take appropriate actions using the COPC corrective action approach. Ensure adherence to company policies and procedures, including quality assurance standards. Handle escalated customer inquiries or complex issues, ensuring prompt resolution. Provide coaching and training to contact center agents to enhance their skills and performance. Foster a positive work environment that encourages employee engagement, motivation, and retention. Prepare and present reports on contact center performance to senior management. Manage staffing levels, shift schedules, and resource allocation to effectively meet customer demand, in accordance with the FM schedule, to maintain the Center KPIs. Manage the contact center budget, including forecasting and cost control. Drive initiatives to enhance the overall customer experience. Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in contact center operations. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategies to improve customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. Familiarity with contact center software and technological solutions. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to change. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic and forward-looking environment that values impact and professional growth.

b4dfee46c3eb2460.description: About the Role Delta Hotels and Resorts® is seeking a Captain Bellstand to join the team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Assist guests and visitors with entering and exiting the hotel, including opening doors. Manage luggage drop-off, retrieval, and transportation to and from guest rooms or bell service. Assist guests and visitors with boarding and exiting vehicles, including loading and unloading luggage. Provide directions and arrange transportation (*, taxi, shuttle), booking in advance as needed. Support colleagues and treat them with dignity and respect to achieve common goals. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. b4e71be2e0da46dd.description: About the Role Gold and Minerals Ltd is seeking a Field Assistant Exploration to join their team in Bishah, 'Asir, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting ongoing exploration field programs under the direction of a Field Supervisor. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conducting trench sampling. Performing drillcore cutting and sampling. Executing RC sampling procedures. Assisting with geophysical surveying. Participating in topographic surveying activities. Carrying out downhole surveys and water monitoring. Handling core trays. Maintaining the core yard. b4a618aacdea1cc6.description: إعلان توظيف: أخصائي إدارة متجر إلكتروني (منصة سلة) ومدخل بيانات – قطاع العناية والتجميل ​نبحث عن شاب طموح ومحترف للانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يتولى إدارة متجرنا الإلكتروني على منصة سلة والإشراف على إدخال وتنسيق بيانات وصور منتجات العناية والتجميل داخل المملكة العربية السعودية. ​المهام الوظيفية: ​إدارة المتجر الشاملة: متابعة لوحة تحكم متجر سلة وتنظيم الأقسام والتصنيفات والواجهات التسويقية. ​إدخال بيانات المنتجات: كتابة عناوين وأوصاف منتجات العناية والتجميل بدقة واحترافية متوافقة مع محركات البحث (SEO). ​تجهيز ورفع الصور: تنسيق صور المنتجات ومقاساتها ورفعها بجودة عالية تعكس هوية المتجر وتجذب العملاء. ​متابعة المخزون والعروض: تحديث الأسعار، الكميات، أكواد الخصم، وربط المنتجات بالعلامات التجارية والتصنيفات الصحيحة. ​الشروط والمتطلبات: ​الخبرة العملية المثبتة: سابقة أعمال فعلية وموثقة في إدارة متاجر سلة (يشترط إرفاق روابط المتاجر أو نماذج الأعمال السابقة عند التقديم، ولن يُنظر في الطلبات التي لا تحتوي على إثبات خبرة). ​المعرفة بقطاع التجميل: خلفية عملية في منتجات العناية بالبشرة والشعر والتجميل وفهم مسمياتها وتصنيفاتها. ​التواجد داخل المملكة: الإقامة داخل المملكة العربية السعودية والإلمام بطبيعة السوق المحلي. ​المهارات التقنية: إتقان استخدام لوحة تحكم سلة، وملفات جدول البيانات لرفع المنتجات، وأدوات تعديل الصور الأساسية. ​طريقة التقديم: يرجى إرسال السيرة الذاتية مع روابط المتاجر التي قمت بإدارتها سابقاً ونماذج من أعمالك في إدخال المنتجات مع كتابة "مدير متجر سلة - عناية وتجميل" في عنوان الرسالة.

Standardize analytics and growth frameworks across markets, reducing manual dependency and improving operational efficiency. Develop data-driven strategies that maximize financial impact while mitigating operational and growth risks.
